description: Hosted FactLot tool (api.factlot.com only). Builds a client-ready document by code, with no model: tx_unequal_appraisal (calc_tx_unequal_appraisal: evidence packet PDF or adjustment-grid workbook with live formulas; send registry_tx_equity_candidates' sources as context.sources to print each cited source's as-of date, URL and rights, the rows of its subject and of the candidates used as comparables as context.candidates (value and improvement area must match the calculation) to print each property's account number, codes, land area and year built as sent, with value per SF computed by FactLot, and its selection_rule as context.selection_rule to print the candidate rule as applied), lease_abstract (doc_abstract_lease), cam_reconciliation (calc_cam_reconciliation or _batch), debt_sizing (calc_debt_sizing), asc842_schedule (calc_lease_remeasurement_asc842), compare_proposals (calc_compare_proposals), dcf_summary (calc_dcf_pro_forma), critical_dates (calc_critical_dates; also ics: a calendar with each notice window and deadline dated on its contractual day and a reminder 30 days before; dates before today are left out unless include_past is true), tx_protest_deadline (rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline on tax_year, notice_delivered_date?, as_of?, or the _batch rule when arguments has items: ics, one calendar with each notice's statutory filing deadline and conservative file-by date as all-day events, reminders 30 and 7 days before the file-by date, the rule's basis, status, warnings and notes in each description, and the rule's next_season dates when the requested year has passed; or pdf, a deadline sheet), property_sheet (pdf or xlsx: one page for one parcel, arguments { urn } only, the parcel's FactLot ID from registry_search_address: FactLot runs registry_get on it as your own call, so it costs one lookup and is gated like any registry_get of yours (free: the current roll year only, with a line naming the earlier years a Pro or Team key adds), then lays out the address, IDs, owner of record when the registry holds an organisation (or why there is none), the linked registered entity as the registry's match with its confidence, values by roll year with each file's as-of date, building and land facts, for a Texas parcel the next general protest deadline under Tex. Tax Code §41.44(a)(1) labelled as the general rule, and every source with its licence or attribution; no context is accepted). Every kind but lease_abstract requires the tool's arguments: FactLot runs the tool on them and builds the document from that run only, so its numbers are FactLot's results; a result sent as input is not used (the answer's result_mismatch says whether it differs). lease_abstract takes doc_abstract_lease's arguments, or its result as input: built from a supplied result, every page says the abstract values are as supplied by the caller and FactLot did not recompute them. Caller text (title, prepared_for, citation locators, comparable ids, labels and reasons, tx_protest_deadline item ids) is printed as supplied by the caller; advice or valuation wording in it is refused (TextNotAllowed). One report per request (one report_create per MCP batch). Returns download_url (works 24 hours), expires_at, bytes, sha256, filename and billed (true when this request counted against the month; every refusal has billed: false); inline: true also returns files under 1 MiB as base64. Counts against reports_per_month (free: 3 a month per IP address; Pro 50; Team 1,000); input errors are free.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments. Required for every kind but lease_abstract: FactLot runs the tool on them and builds the document from that run only. tx_protest_deadline: rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline's (tax_year, notice_delivered_date?, as_of?), or with items the _batch rule's (items: [{id, tax_year, notice_delivered_date?}], as_of?). property_sheet: { urn } only, a parcel's FactLot ID; FactLot runs registry_get on it for the caller (gated and counted as the caller's lookup).

context.description: Optional title, prepared-for line, and citations (text only).

candidates.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: the rows of registry_tx_equity_candidates' `subject` and `candidates` for this calculation's subject and comparables only, as returned, matched by id. Each row's value and improvement_area_sf must equal that subject's or comparable's in the calculation, and every id must be one of them (InputError otherwise). The packet and workbook print the account number (apn), state property category, building class, local use code, land area and year built as sent, and value per SF computed from the calculation's value and area.

comparable_citations.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: citations by comparable id (or #1, #2 … for comparables without an id), for comparables whose result carries none. A citation in the result is kept; one here for the same comparable is listed beside it.

prepared_for.description: Who the report is prepared for, printed under the title.

selection_rule.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: the `selection_rule` of registry_tx_equity_candidates as returned. The packet and workbook print FactLot's default candidate rule with the parameters, narrowing, step counts and tier counts applied.

enum: on the district's roll for the tax year, with exactly the subject's state property category code, a positive improvement area and an appraised or market value
improvement area within area_band of the subject's
year built within year_band years of the subject's, when both are known
local use code exactly the subject's (same_local_use_code)
local use code one of local_use_codes

sources.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: the `sources` of registry_tx_equity_candidates (or registry_get) as returned: each cited document_id with its title, uri, as_of and rights (ai_use, redistribution, license, attribution). The packet's Sources and rights block prints each cited source with its as-of date, URL and rights; a source sent without rights, or a right of "unknown", is printed as not stated by the publisher.

subject_citation.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: where the subject's value comes from (document_id, locator, as_of, fact_id).

title.description: Report title shown on the cover, e.g. the property or lease name. Defaults to one from the result.

format.description: xlsx, pdf, or ics (critical_dates and tx_protest_deadline). tx_protest_deadline comes as ics or pdf; property_sheet as pdf or xlsx.

include_past.description: ics only: also put dates before today in the calendar (critical_dates: today in UTC; tx_protest_deadline: today in US Central time, and the passed tax year's dates beside next season's). By default they are left out.

inline.description: Also return the file as base64 (an embedded resource) when it is under 1 MiB.

input.description: lease_abstract only: the doc_abstract_lease result, used when arguments are not sent (each page then says the values are the caller's). For other kinds a result sent here is not used; the answer says whether it matches FactLot's run (result_mismatch).

name: report_create
title: Create a client-ready report (XLSX, PDF, ICS)
